android_mechanism: Repeated category-ID lookup executed for every imported row; fix caches IDs in memory
bug_description: Every time a page finishes loading, onSaveHistory -> RdbUtils.insertDate re-queries the date_table for the current date and re-runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for the per-day history table, even though the same date is looked up on every save within a session. The redundant query + DDL run on each page navigation and add avoidable RDB round-trips to the page-save path.
fix_summary: Cache already-verified per-day tables in an in-memory Set (RdbUtils.knownDates); insertDate returns early on cache hit, and deleteAll clears the cache.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

evidence.note: 980M vs 427M instructions (2.3x); cpu 5949 vs 2495 ms; 3000 vs 1002 statements

mechanism_oracle.definition: Count of RDB statement executions attributable to history saving (date_table SELECT + CREATE TABLE + history INSERT) per page load, from disk/sqlite activity in the hitrace trace or RDB debug logs.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed: >= 3 statements per page save after the first (SELECT + CREATE TABLE + INSERT); fixed: 1 statement per page save (INSERT only). Overall page-save wall time in trace drops accordingly.

reproduction: git -C hosts/browser checkout case/browser_insert_date_lookup_cache/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/browser checkout case/browser_insert_date_lookup_cache/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
